episode_row: ops state (data/picks markers, health_state) existed only on the box — no backup until restic (7/10)

commits.subject: feat(backup): restic encrypted versioned backup of operational state (audit F5)
commits.body:
data/picks (decisions, contest ledger, manual saver flag, skip-shadow
markers) and data/health_state existed ONLY on the box: gitignored,
excluded from the R2 artifact sync, no provider snapshot. Box loss =
irrecoverable operational state; the saver flag is deliberately not
inferable, so it cannot be reconstructed.

- bts.data.backup: restic wrapper (encrypted/versioned/deduped) against
  the existing R2 bucket under restic/. Two sets: ops (picks+health,
  cron 3h) and archive (leaderboard/hetzner_results/external research
  data, daily). Secrets flow via subprocess env only, never argv;
  status file preserves last_success_at across failures so freshness
  measures real data-loss exposure.
- bts backup run/status/prune/restore-drill CLI; restore-drill proves
  the two claims F5 demands (saver + decision provenance come back).
- backup_freshness health source (Tier 3, always-attention): stale ops
  7h WARN / 26h CRITICAL, archive 30h/78h; absent status file = silent
  (not armed, e.g. local dev).
- scripts/install-restic-hetzner.sh: pinned 0.19.1, SHA256SUMS-verified,
  no root (~/.local/bin).
